ideas: Start with the question "What would Socrates do today?" then flash a striking line from "The Republic" with fast‑paced city footage, ending with a 5‑second reflection prompt.
Show a split‑screen: left side a dusty manuscript, right side a trending TikTok dance; overlay a Stoic quote about action, syncing cuts to the beat.

avoid: Overused royalty‑free uplifting music without contextual tie‑in
